page.content:
All-powerful cloud that drops animals and holds a City Council seat.

How the Glow Cloud connects

  • Location: Night Vale — The Glow Cloud hangs over Night Vale and later sits on its council.
  • Work: Welcome to Night Vale (show) — The show's community calendar includes hailing the Glow Cloud.
  • Faction: Night Vale City Council — The Glow Cloud holds a seat on the Night Vale City Council.

What is the Glow Cloud?

The Glow Cloud is the fluorescent, animal-dropping, civic entity Night Vale is instructed to hail; it later sits on the City Council and remains a weather report that is also a god.

Key threads lead to Night Vale, Welcome to Night Vale (show) and Night Vale City Council.
